rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I (ACCME or WSMA accredited sponsorship) – all 200 hours may be Category I; Category II non-accredited, III teaching, IV publications/exhibits, V self-directed – max 80 hours each
rules.alternatives: Instead of 200 hours: current AMA Physician's Recognition Award in at least 2 of the 4 years before renewal; ABMS member board certification in the 4 years before renewal; or meeting ABMS maintenance of certification requirements at renewal.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Suicide and opioid one-time trainings are due by the end of the first full CE reporting period after initial licensure. Postgraduate/limited licenses have no CME requirement.
rules.audit_note: Signed declaration of compliance at renewal (WAC 246-12-180); up to 25% randomly audited after renewal, documents due within 60 days (WAC 246-12-190).

topics.who: All physicians except residents with limited license; exempt if brief/limited or no patient contact; course on DOH model list
Physicians who prescribe opioids in Washington

rules.notes: License renews every 2 years on the birthday; CME is reported every 4 years. Renewal fee $824 plus HEAL-WA ($32) and physician health program ($140) surcharges. Residency/fellowship can count 50 Category I hours per year.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 (min 60 hours: 1-A formal programs by nationally recognized osteopathic/medical sponsors incl. AOA, AMA, accredited schools/hospitals, interactive online; 1-B papers; 1-C teaching, max 45); Category 2 (2-A home study max 90, 2-B exhibits max 30, 2-C other max 30)
rules.alternatives: Instead of 150 hours: ABOMS or ABMS certification/recertification within the last 6 years; meeting ABOMS/ABMS maintenance of certification at renewal; current AOA certificate of excellence in CME; or current AMA PRA. State-specific mandated topics still apply.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Suicide and opioid one-time trainings are due by the end of the first full CE reporting period after initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: Signed declaration of compliance at renewal (WAC 246-12-180); up to 25% randomly audited after renewal, documents due within 60 days (WAC 246-12-190).

topics.who: All osteopathic physicians except postgraduate training limited license; course on DOH model list
Osteopathic physicians who prescribe opioids in Washington

rules.notes: Separate board: Washington Board of Osteopathic Medicine and Surgery (Dept. of Health). License renews every year on the birthday; CME counted over 36 months. Health equity: 2 hours every 4 years.
